identity_reason: it is a glass Button and an inset List with IconButtons, so its look comes from those parts and only the refusal line is new
concept: A button that opens the file chooser and the list of chosen files, each with its size and a remove button; refusals are said in words.

root.why: the button row, the refusals and the list stack with an even gap

head.why: the button and its hint share one row and wrap on a narrow pane

hint.why: the hint is secondary at label size and says what is accepted

glyph.why: the upload arrow, file and cross are drawn with the ring stroke at icon size

list.why: chosen files sit on one level-2 pane like an inset list

file.why: each file row keeps a 44px height with its name, size and remove button

name.why: the file name is primary at body size and wraps instead of spilling

size.why: the size is secondary in tabular figures at the end of the row

refused.why: a refused file is listed with its reason in words and only the bullet takes the critical mark

data-invalid.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words
